office: the Royal Oman Police, Directorate General of Civil Status

routes.label: at a Royal Oman Police civil status office

note: Royal Oman Police Decision 157/2025 (2 November 2025), amending the executive regulations of the Civil Status Law: the personal card is valid ten Gregorian years from issue or renewal and must be renewed within 30 days of expiry; issue and renewal cost RO 10, as does replacing a damaged or lost card. The ages at which the card is due and the time to issue aren't in the decision, so every age is offered and the time is null.

sources.title: Royal Oman Police, Decision 157/2025 amending certain provisions of the executive regulations of the Civil Status Law (Qanoon.om)
